working_tree_scope: Content workflow, recipe, and tests recorded in the working tree that adds them, on top of the base revision. Re-run the command on the PR head.

environment.execution: CPU lexical rule; no neural inference and no decision HTTP call

command: OMNI_BASE_URL= OMNI_API_KEY= uv run python -m s1a.content run --items recipes/content-workflow/items.jsonl --picks recipes/content-workflow/picks.json --publish recipes/content-workflow/publish.json --backend rule
sanitization: The full report stays under runs/, which is gitignored. Counts below are from that report.
verification_output: Verified the fixture workflow; nothing was published

negative_verifier_checks.stderr: human pick gate: pass picks, answer the prompt, or pass --allow-unsafe-skip-gates (unsafe: it invents a pick and holds every item; it still does not publish)
